text: While preparing a meal, garlic is a fundamental ingredient that imparts a robust flavor to virtually every dish. Its strong aroma is a result of allicin, an organic compound that forms when garlic is crushed, chopped, or minced. As a staple in countless recipes, garlic enhances the taste of proteins, vegetables, and sauces, making it a beloved secret ingredient among cooks. Its versatility and ability to stand out in a blend make it indispensable in the culinary arts. Following its natural aging process, onions are commonly added to dishes later in the cooking process, transforming their sweet, earthy flavor into a base for various sauces and fried dishes. Together, garlic and onions work in harmony, each contributing unique layers of taste that elevate a simple recipe into a rich and flavorful experience.
